R261.note: Single-line reroute of the handler registration from apiMux to the CSRF-protected protectedMux; minimal and correct.

R262.note: createCipher -> createCipheriv with PBKDF2-derived key and AES-256-GCM; response now also carries salt/iv/authTag, which is necessary for decryption and is disclosed.

R263.note: math/rand.Intn replaced with crypto/rand.Read into 16 bytes, base64-encoded; adds error handling.

R264.note: text/template swapped for html/template; template and Execute() call untouched, escaping becomes automatic.

R265.note: Adds scheme + host allowlist (and relative-path allowlist) before sendRedirect; non-matching destinations rejected with a message instead of redirecting.

R266.note: Adds an offset+length bounds check; the primary clamp variant truncates over-length reads instead of erroring, which is explicitly called out as a stated tradeoff alongside a stricter alternative.

R267.note: Adds Secure = true to the existing CookieOptions initializer; nothing else changes.

R268.note: Wraps ticketRef in HttpUtility.HtmlEncode() at the exact concatenation point.

R269.note: Key resolver now fetches from a hardcoded trusted JWKS URI instead of the token's own jku claim, plus a RS256-only ValidAlgorithms allowlist closing the alg-confusion path.

R270.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forPropertyAccessors(order) is a type error: that factory takes PropertyAccessor... varargs, not the evaluation root object, so this will not compile; even fixed to compile, the root object is never bound to the context (it belongs in expression.getValue(context, order)), so the presented code is not a working fix and doesn't say so.

R271.note: Generic 'Invalid order ID format' message replaces e.getMessage(), with logger.warn(e) preserving server-side detail; success path unchanged.

R272.note: Applies the file's own escapeAuthorName to entry.rawComment, the actual unescaped field reaching the HTML sink.

R273.note: unserialize() replaced with json_decode() plus explicit typed field copy into a fresh ShoppingCart; format change from PHP serialization to JSON is inherent to the standard CWE-502 fix and is disclosed.

R274.note: escape-html wraps closingNote before template interpolation; rest of the handler unchanged.

R275.note: HTML::Entities encode_entities() wraps only the flagged $cgi->param('note') call, matching scope of the reported sink.

R276.note: Adds PNG/JPEG magic-byte validation (replacing the trusted Content-Type header) and a random hex filename with a content-derived extension; legitimate PNG/JPEG uploads still succeed, filename-format change is disclosed.

R277.note: strcpy/strcat replaced with snprintf(destination, dest_size, ...) and the call site updated to pass sizeof(display_name); truncation on oversized names is disclosed.

R278.note: AES-ECB replaced with AES-GCM plus a random 12-byte nonce; response now prepends the nonce (needed for decryption), disclosed and necessary.

R279.note: @PreAuthorize + ownership-bean shape is right, but DocumentSecurity.isOwnedBy() is delivered as 'return false; // placeholder', so every delete including the legitimate owner's is denied; the write-up does flag it as a placeholder needing real implementation.

R280.note: ldap3's escape_filter_chars() applied to username before building the filter string; RFC 4515-correct.

R281.note: Guid.NewGuid() replaced with RandomNumberGenerator-backed 32-byte hex token; dictionary keying by string is unaffected.

R282.note: Adds an RFC 4515 LDAP-filter-metacharacter escaping helper applied before filter construction.

R283.note: Adds offset > capacity check before length > capacity - offset, closing both the missing-offset-check and the potential size_t underflow; in-bounds calls behave identically.

R284.note: Generic 'Unable to retrieve receipt' message replaces str(e), with logger.exception() preserving server-side detail; success path unchanged.

R285.note: Adds a per-handler ALLOWED_METHODS whitelist checked in the resolver before the method name ever reaches the dispatcher; legitimate email.send still resolves.

R286.note: Adds can:refund,order middleware backed by an OrderPolicy comparing user id to order owner; owning user still succeeds, others get 403 as intended.

R287.note: Adds secure: true to the existing cookie options object; nothing else changes.

R288.note: Markup(label), which disables escaping, is replaced with escape(label); template structure and other fields unchanged.

R289.note: Adds a host allowlist check (null host for relative, or example.org/www.example.org) before sendRedirect, rejecting other hosts with 403.

R290.note: Shell invocation replaced entirely with Go's archive/tar reader; archiveName is now only a filename passed to os.Open, and per-entry output mirrors tar -tf's format.

R291.note: Hand-rolled inline Redis protocol replaced with redis-py's hset(), which handles RESP encoding; call arguments map directly onto the original cache_key/field/value write.

R292.note: new Random(seed) replaced with SecureRandom(), and the attacker-controlled seed input is dropped entirely, as instructed in prose rather than a full file diff.

R293.note: Math.random() replaced with SecureRandom-backed 16-byte base64 token; format change (digits -> base64) is inconsequential since the value is only stored/compared as an opaque string.

R294.note: get_object_or_404(Invoice, pk=pk) replaced with self.get_object(), which applies get_queryset() scoping and triggers has_object_permission(); the resulting access restriction is the intended fix, not an incidental side effect.

R295.note: String-concatenated SQL replaced with a parameterized SqlCommand/@Region bound via SqlDataAdapter; DataTable/Fill contract preserved.

R296.note: Disables DOCTYPE declarations, external general/parameter entities, external DTD loading, and sets ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD/SCHEMA to empty before building the parser; legitimate DTD-less order XML is unaffected.

R297.note: Same case and same correct snprintf(dest_size)-based fix as R277.

R298.note: Inline command text replaced with a length-prefixed RESP array immune to embedded CRLF; the *7 in the explanatory comment miscounts the 6-element array, but BuildRespArray uses elements.Length so the actual wire output is correct.

R299.note: Adds a scheme allowlist (http/https, relative paths, #) before attribute-escaping, falling back to '#' for javascript:/data: and other disallowed schemes.

R300.note: Adds a real AccountId-vs-NameIdentifier-claim comparison returning Forbid() on mismatch, not a stub; matching owner still gets the file.
